prompt: The client wants to know why its company-wide on-time delivery rate fell this year. Which takeaway matters most?

options.text: The North stayed within 2 points of 95% all year
options.feedback: True, but it describes the region that didn't change. The question is why the company-wide rate fell.

options.text: Nearly all the decline is in the South
options.feedback: Right. The South fell from 94% to 78%; the North stayed between 94% and 96%.

options.text: Both regions slipped in March and kept falling
options.feedback: The North rose in March, from 94% to 95%. Only the South fell.

options.text: Driver shortages in the South caused the drop
options.feedback: The chart shows where on-time delivery fell, not why. That may be true, but nothing here supports it.

explanation: The South fell from 94% to 78%; the North stayed between 94% and 96%.

extras.proof: The South fell from 94% to 78%; the North stayed between 94% and 96%.
